name: Thomas Product Capability 50
description: Fifty repo-grounded and product-grounded Thomas capability tasks covering skills, plugins, routing, UI visibility, browser work, desktop work, testing, and artifact generation.
protocol: Run Thomas through the current product lane, not a fake harness.
Do not manually create artifacts outside the benchmark prompts.
Use tool execution, repo inspection, browser access, and desktop actions when needed.
Treat missing files, wrong formats, and unverifiable claims as failures.

tasks.title: Config Default Model JSON
tasks.prompt: Use your tools to read thomas.toml and write {{artifact_dir}}/task01_config_default_model.json with JSON keys default_model and model_count. Return one line confirming task01_config_default_model.json was written.
